en: Hey, look at that... That's one helluva{SAUT}wicked axe it's luggin' around.

Mmhm, and what a scary face it has...{SAUT}Could it be upset for some reason?{PAGE}We have Hikari-chan with us, so it{SAUT}would be best to try and avoid enemies{SAUT}who would give us trouble in a fight.
Then, what should we do now?
Let's lure it away with some bait.{OPTION}Let's consult Noir.
Yeah―it worked once for us already,{SAUT}so I think we should try it again.
N-No! ...We should go with a more solid{SAUT}plan this time.{PAGE}Why don't we ask Noir for advice, as our{SAUT}resident axe expert?
Right. She wields an axe herself, so she{SAUT}could be of help with this.

Well... axes have a rather short attack{SAUT}range, so it's best not to get too close.{PAGE}Also, an axe that large seems awfully{SAUT}heavy, so I doubt it can swing that{SAUT}continually―only one whack at a time.
I see... "Don't approach it if possible,"{SAUT}and, "Time it well if you must approach{SAUT}it," seem to be the best tactics here.
{f 0 1 2}Its expression{f 0 1 0} may make for a useful{SAUT}clue with its attack timing, too.{PAGE}Doesn't it seem like it would be the most{SAUT}dangerous when it's at its angriest?
That would make sense. We'll leave our{SAUT}dodge timing up to you, Joker.
